master.bio_short: Fourth-generation Kanihama pashmina weaver. Taught by his father Ghulam Mohammad. Specialises in kani-stick twill-tapestry shawls.

lineage.name: Ghulam Mohammad
lineage.notes: Father; introduced the master to the loom at age 9.

lineage.name: Habibullah Sheikh
lineage.notes: Father's master; passed away before Mohammad Yusuf began weaving.

lineage.text_ks: Mohammad Yusuf chuun naav. Bo chus Kanihama gaamuk. Mein walid Ghulam Mohammad chu mein ustaad.
lineage.text_en: My name is Mohammad Yusuf. I am from Kanihama village. My father Ghulam Mohammad was my teacher.

lineage.text_ks: Asuund silsila chu chowmuk peshe; mein dada Habibullah Sahab chu pyath suri kani-shawal banawaan.
lineage.text_en: Ours is a fourth-generation lineage; my grandfather Habibullah Sahab first started weaving kani shawls.

lineage.text_ks: Bo chus 1962 manz peshe shuru kornu, nau wari umar manz, mein walid sund pyath beth-ith.
lineage.text_en: I started weaving in 1962, at the age of nine, sitting next to my father.

technique.text_ks: Yi chu kani-buti technique; kani su chu lakhdaar, fer su chu reshmuk dhaaga ferkav karun.
technique.text_en: This is the kani-buti technique; the kani is a wooden stick, and we wrap silk thread around it.

technique.text_ks: Ek inch karuk peth chu sath se nuv knot kara; har knot chu hath sund pyath, machine kati.
technique.text_en: Per inch of carpet we make seven to nine knots; each knot is by hand, never by machine.

technique.text_ks: Pehl chu warpa tani parav, fer chu wuf reshmuk dhaaga changthangi mool wuchun, fer chu rangu lagav.
technique.text_en: First we set the warp; then we comb the changthangi wool into silk thread; then we apply colour.

technique.text_ks: Kani su chu shahtut kati banav, akh shawal banawne aase aath maas chu lagaan.
technique.text_en: The kani-stick is made from mulberry wood. One full shawl takes about eight months.

technique.text_ks: Galti chu paaye gov shaagird suit kani galat pakkar karav; pyath kani phati, soot phati, design rachu.
technique.text_en: The mistake an apprentice makes is gripping the kani wrong; if the kani slips the thread breaks and the design is ruined.

decisions.text_ks: Wool wuchne khaatre, bo karun chus gund manz hath legith. Agar gund chu narm te thur, soit chu theek; agar khoshk chu, dyut karav.
decisions.text_en: To judge wool, I take a lock between thumb and forefinger and roll it. If the lock is soft and slightly oily, the lot is right; if it is dry, we reject it.

decisions.text_ks: Sard mausam manz warpa tension chu tang, fer chu zaror reshmu pyath panieek halka chiknav, na te dhaaga phathi.
decisions.text_en: In cold weather the warp tension is tight, so I lightly mist the silk thread with water; otherwise the thread snaps.

decisions.text_ks: Mein walid gaov mein zindagi sund sa-zad galti theek kar; bo paani-rang sa-zad lagaaw, ti panie ziyaad lagaaw.
decisions.text_en: The mistake my father corrected most often when I was young: I would apply too much water to the colour, and that would over-dilute the dye.

decisions.text_ks: Yim dukandaar saath kor wadla, soit kalu pheri pyath wadla; theek dukandaar chu ek mausam manz akh dah lota wadalan, ziyaad nat.
decisions.text_en: If a supplier changes the dye lot mid-season, that is a warning sign; a trustworthy supplier sells from one batch per season, not more.

suppliers.text_ks: Soot chu Ladakh, Changthang ilaakas pyath aatsh; yim phaan changpa kabila aase; rabita chu chui-tih saal poran.
suppliers.text_en: Wool comes from Ladakh's Changthang region; we buy from the Changpa nomads. The relationship is over forty years old.

suppliers.text_ks: Reshmu Banaras pyath aatsh; rangu chu Srinagar manz Maharaj-Gunj qadeem dukan pyath aatsh, naam zaror lukheth nay.
suppliers.text_en: Silk comes from Banaras; dyes come from an old shop in Maharaj Gunj, Srinagar — I do not want the name made public.

suppliers.text_ks: Wool aane ka mausam chu november manz; soit chu sard te seal-pak, theek wool ki nishani chu.
suppliers.text_en: The wool arrives in November; the cold and the smell-of-fold are the signs of a good lot.

piece.short_summary: Kani-buti pashmina shawl, 4th-generation Kanihama lineage, 8 months on the loom.
